subject: ECN {{ECN_Number}} submitted for review
body: An engineering change notice has been submitted by {{Submitted_By}} and is ready for initial review.

subject: ECN {{ECN_Number}} assigned to analyst
body: The change request has been assigned to {{Analyst_Name}} for impact assessment and routing.

subject: Approval required for ECN {{ECN_Number}}
body: Please review the proposed change, affected items, cost impact, and implementation plan before approving.

subject: ECN {{ECN_Number}} approved
body: The engineering change notice has completed approval and is ready for release activities.

subject: ECN {{ECN_Number}} rejected
body: The submitted change has been rejected. Review the comments from the approver and update the request if needed.

subject: Implementation due for ECN {{ECN_Number}}
body: The implementation task for this approved change is approaching its planned completion date.

subject: ECO {{ECO_Number}} released
body: The engineering change order has been released and applicable item revisions are now available to downstream teams.

subject: New revision created for {{Item_Number}}
body: A new item revision has been created as part of the approved change process.

subject: BOM change requested for {{Assembly_Number}}
body: A bill of material update has been requested. Validate component quantities, alternates, and reference designators.

subject: Manufacturer {{Manufacturer_Name}} approved
body: The manufacturer record has been approved for use in sourcing and approved manufacturer lists.

subject: Supplier quote required for {{Item_Number}}
body: Procurement approval requires an updated supplier quote before the change can proceed.

subject: Quality review required for ECN {{ECN_Number}}
body: Quality assurance review is required due to potential inspection, compliance, or customer impact.

subject: Procurement review required for ECN {{ECN_Number}}
body: Procurement review is required to confirm availability, supplier readiness, and purchasing impact.

subject: Finance approval required for ECN {{ECN_Number}}
body: The estimated cost impact exceeds the configured finance threshold and requires finance approval.

subject: Manufacturing review required for ECN {{ECN_Number}}
body: Manufacturing review is required to confirm work instruction updates, tooling readiness, and production timing.

subject: Document {{Document_Number}} marked obsolete
body: The controlled document has been obsoleted as part of the change and should no longer be used for production.

subject: Firmware package {{Firmware_Version}} released
body: The firmware package has been released and is available for approved product configurations.

subject: CAPA linked to ECN {{ECN_Number}}
body: A corrective action has been linked to this engineering change for traceability and follow up.

subject: Test failure recorded for {{Item_Number}}
body: A validation test has failed. Review the attached test results and determine whether the change requires revision.

subject: Reference designator check warning
body: The reference designator validation found a mismatch between the assembly BOM and expected component placement.

subject: Weekly engineering change summary
body: This summary lists open, approved, rejected, and implemented changes for the current reporting week.

subject: System configuration updated
body: A system configuration record was updated. Administrators should confirm approval thresholds and routing flags.

subject: Item {{Item_Number}} inactivated
body: The item record has been set to inactive and should not be selected for new change requests.

subject: Approved manufacturer status review needed
body: An approved manufacturer list entry requires review to confirm continued sourcing eligibility.

subject: Change request {{ECN_Number}} cancelled
body: The change request has been cancelled and no further workflow action is required.
